subject: Recap: Redwood demo + pricing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@marketpulse.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood demo + pricing next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sofia 

really enjoyed the conversation and the product context you shared. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on pricing/unit economics with Finance: 

- Token volumes: you mentioned a pilot at ~10M tokens/month with expected steady-state of 20-30M tokens/mo depending on rollout. Please confirm if that matches internal forecasts.
- Budget range: initial guidance you gave was in the $80k- $120k/month range (we flagged this for sizing). Need confirmation if that’s committed budget or planning range.
- Stakeholders: can you confirm the budget owner and economic buyer? You mentioned Lena Park (Finance) owns procurement and Raj Patel (CTO) is the technical sponsor - would love to confirm.
- Unit economics ask: to make finance comfortable we typically provide a $/1M tokens target and a simple cost breakdown (platform fee, inference unit cost, margin). Can you share target $/1M tokens or a target monthly spend so we can map to recommended config?

Proposed next steps:
1) Share a concise finance packet (1-2 slides + SOW draft) aimed at Lena - I attached a first-pass pricing_estimate_v1.pdf and a short finance summary XLSX.
2) Intro to Lena + a 30-min call next week to align on unit economics and procurement timeline.
3) We’ll prepare a SOW + procurement checklist for Legal once finance signals go-ahead.

If you confirm Lena and Raj as the right people, I’ll loop them in and propose two time slots for the finance call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments:
- pricing_estimate_v1.pdf (PDF)
- redwood_finance_summary.xlsx (Excel)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@marketpulse.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@marketpulse.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood demo + pricing next steps

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Quick answers below: 

- Volumes: pilot will be ~10M tokens/mo (customer-facing assistant for 2 products). If pilot looks good we expect to ramp to ~25M tokens/mo over 3-4 months.
- Budget: the $80k- $120k/mo is a planning range; finance is looking at an initial committed band closer to $70k- $100k/mo for this fiscal quarter.
- Stakeholders: confirmed - Lena Park (VP Finance) will own the budget and sign off on procurement. Contact: Lena Park <lena.park@marketpulse.com>. Raj Patel (CTO) is the technical/economic buyer and will validate latency/cost tradeoffs. I’m copying Raj here.

Two asks from our side to make the finance call productive: 
1) Could you include a short comparison of $/1M tokens at three consumption bands (10M / 25M / 50M) showing estimated monthly cost and expected primary levers (batching, quantization)?
2) Share a one-page SOW draft so our procurement team can pre-scan terms.

Happy to be on the call; please loop Lena and propose times next week (Tue/Wed mornings PT work best).

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Product Partnerships | MarketPulse
sofia@marketpulse.com

Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Finance call proposal (Redwood x MarketPulse)

Hi Lena and Raj - Sofia kindly introduced us. Quick note on what we’ll cover so the call is productive: 

- 15 min: finance-friendly pricing summary (pricing bands at 10M / 25M / 50M tokens) - includes estimated $/1M tokens and monthly totals.
- 10 min: technical constraints that affect cost (latency SLOs, batching/opportunity for quantization).
- 5 min: procurement timeline and SOW next steps.

Preliminary example (subject to final config):
- 10M tokens/mo = ~$12,000/month => ~$1,200 per 1M tokens
- 25M tokens/mo = ~$26,250/month => ~$1,050 per 1M tokens (volume discount + batching savings)
- 50M tokens/mo = ~$45,000/month => ~$900 per 1M tokens (further discounts + reserved capacity)

I attached a 1-page SOW draft (SOW_draft.docx) and a short spreadsheet that breaks the numbers into compute + platform + support margin. If these preliminary numbers look in the ballpark, could we set a 30-min call on Tue 23 Jun 9:30-10:00 AM PT or Wed 24 Jun 10:00-10:30 AM PT? I’ll also include a one-page finance slide tailored to Lena.

Thanks and welcome,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments:
- SOW_draft.docx (Word)
- redwood_finance_summary.xlsx (Excel)
